labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Salesforce Records Sync grants
labels.value: Open the Campaign sync, Opportunity mirror and Gift Transaction mirror pages and edit the IDs they keep. Creating Campaigns, Opportunities or Gift Transactions also needs that object's access in Setup.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Accounting Export grants
labels.value: Download gifts as a CSV file for your accounting system and mark them posted. Reads the gift fields the file shows, so it needs no Giving set beside it.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what Inbound Gifts grants
labels.value: For an integration, flow or AI assistant user only: record gifts another system sends, through the Inbound Gift API or the Record Inbound Gift action. It needs nothing else from BarnCRM.
